senses.sense_definition: Het uitwisselen van goederen of diensten voor geld of andere goederen.

examples.text: De internationale <w>koophandel</w> is de laatste jaren sterk gegroeid.

target_lang_translations.en: International <w>trade</w> has grown strongly in recent years.

examples.text: Veel steden werden rijk door de bloeiende <w>koophandel</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: Many cities became wealthy through flourishing <w>commerce</w>.

target_lang_definitions.en: The exchange of goods or services for money or other goods.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: General term for the exchange of goods and services.
Refers to the activity of buying and selling on a large scale.

senses.sense_definition: Het proces van goederen inkopen om ze vervolgens met winst door te verkopen.

examples.text: In de Gouden Eeuw was de <w>koophandel</w> de drijvende kracht van de welvaart.

target_lang_translations.en: In the Golden Age, <w>trading</w> was the driving force of prosperity.

examples.text: Hij verdiende zijn geld met de <w>koophandel</w> in zeldzame specerijen.

target_lang_translations.en: He earned his money through the <w>trade</w> of rare spices.

target_lang_definitions.en: The process of purchasing goods to subsequently resell them for profit.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Historical context of trade and profit-seeking.
The activity of promoting and selling goods.
The act of buying and selling goods for profit.
